Authors

Important Dates

Key deadlines for paper submission, notification, registration, and the ISICAS 2026 symposium in Torino, Italy.

Paper Submission Deadlines

ISICAS 2026 uses different submission deadlines depending on the selected IEEE journal track. Authors should confirm the correct track before submitting their manuscripts.

11 May 2026 TCAS-I, TBioCAS, TCAS-AI, TVLSI
1 June 2026 TCAS-II, OJCAS

Conference Timeline

11 May 2026

Submission Deadline

Deadline for TCAS-I, TBioCAS, TCAS-AI, and TVLSI submissions.

1 June 2026

Submission Deadline

Deadline for TCAS-II and OJCAS submissions.

14 September 2026

Acceptance Notification

Authors will be notified of the review outcome for ISICAS 2026 submissions.

28 September 2026

Registration Opens

Registration for ISICAS 2026 opens after acceptance notifications.

4–6 December 2026

ISICAS 2026

The symposium will take place in Torino, Italy.

Important Submission Note

When submitting a paper for ISICAS 2026, please select “ISICAS 2026 Special Issue” in the appropriate journal submission system.
